headerSpan: usecase parser publication and normalized AST accepts the header at EOF and publishes an empty AST
jsonIdSpan: usecase parser publication and normalized AST locates the JSON id son even when it is a substring of the json keyword
failedPublication: usecase parser publication and normalized AST isolates success, clear, failure, and a second success across singleton reuse
collisionOrigin: usecase parser publication and normalized AST names both exact locations and the source labels for generated and explicit ID collisions
unquotedToken: usecase parser publication and normalized AST still rejects a brace inside an unquoted label
grammarLocation: usecase parser publication and normalized AST locates rejected 'JSON' content inside a boundary
metadataLocation: usecase parser publication and normalized AST reports exact actor metadata and incompatible icon locations
relationKind: usecase parser publication and normalized AST rejects mixed-kind generalization and actor include at the exact relation span
classTarget: usecase parser publication and normalized AST rejects duplicate and unknown edge class/style targets with exact locations
noteTarget: usecase parser publication and normalized AST rejects notes targeting JSON, boundary, and explicit edge IDs with both locations
jsonRelation: usecase parser publication and normalized AST rejects JSON in boundaries and JSON semantic or circle relations at exact locations
edgeAnimation: usecase parser publication and normalized AST publishes exact true, fast, slow, and false animation state and rejects invalid values
astAnimation: usecase parser publication and normalized AST publishes exact true, fast, slow, and false animation state and rejects invalid values
astJson: usecase parser publication and normalized AST publishes a complete serializable AST v1 with ordered statements and exact spans

operator: usecase Chevrotain lexer uses longest operator and delimiter precedence
keyword: usecase Chevrotain lexer keeps exact keywords out of longer identifiers and matches semantic words case-insensitively
newline: usecase Chevrotain lexer emits one token per physical newline for carriage return and line feed
jsonLocation: usecase Chevrotain lexer balances nested JSON while ignoring escaped quotes and braces in strings
unclosedMarkdown: usecase Chevrotain lexer consumes unclosed Markdown and stereotypes once instead of rescanning every suffix
decimal: usecase Chevrotain lexer lexes digit-leading ids as identifiers while decimals stay numbers
